payload.title: a merge on the notebook-gaps line has a non-conventional subject
payload.body: Merge commit e2f3460f on plan/notebook-gaps has the subject 'merge: signify-outside-core of notebook-gaps'. config-conventional refuses that subject (type-enum), and .github/workflows/release.yml says main's history is conventional by policy. The commit-msg hook did not run because the line worktree had no node_modules when the merge was made. Every later merge on the line uses 'chore(merge): ...'. A squash or rebase merge at release would avoid carrying it to main. Rewriting the line is the operator's decision.
